newsitem.title: USA: WesBanco sets shr buyback on Shawnee buy.
newsitem.headline: WesBanco sets shr buyback on Shawnee buy.

text.p: WesBanco Inc Monday said it will repurchase shares of its stock in connection with its previously announced acquisition of Shawnee Bank Inc.

As part of the acqusition, valued at near $10 million, WesBanco said it expects to issue up to 323,280 shares of common stock to Shawnee shareholders. Some of the shares will be obtained from the company's Treasury balance, while the remaining shares to be purchased in the market.
Shares will be acquired over a time period between March 3, 1997, and July 31, 1997.
The acquisition should be completed as close to June 30, 1997, as possible, WesBanco said.
Shawnee, with offices located in South Charleston and Dunbar, West Virginia, will be merged into WesBanco Bank South Hills, a wholly owned subsidiary of WesBanco Inc.
